To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
protein phosphatase 1 and 1A play a critical role in cytokine-induced β 2-integrin dependent adhesion in human CD4+T cell lines.
IL-2 induces adhesion through the β 2 integrin, and this process is mediated by protein phosphatase 1 and 1A.
IL-2 induced T cell adhesion is mediated by protein phosphatase 1A (PP2A) and that PP2A may be an important link between IL-2R and β 2 - integrin adhesion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of protein phosphatases 2A (PPII) and 1 (PP1) in IL-2-mediated β2-integrin dependent homotypic adhesions of human T cell clones.
the molecular mechanisms of T cell activation.
the role of protein phosphatases in the signal transduction of IL-2.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IL-2 induced T cell adhesion is mediated by a phosphatase cascade involving PP2A.
the IL-2R is coupled to β 2 - integrin mediated homotypic adhesions through a PP2A-dependent mechanism.
the PP2A is involved in IL- 2-induced β 1 - and β 2 - integrin dependent adhesion of T cell clones, whereas PP1 is not involved in this process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PP2A is an essential regulator of β 2 - integrin dependent homotypic adhesions of T cells.
PP2A is involved in β 2 integrin dependent T cell adhesion, but that the exact mechanism by which PP2A regulates this process is still unknown.

the IL-2R is coupled to the β2-integrin adhesion pathway via the serine/threonin phosphatase PP2A, and that the PP2A inhibitor okadaic acid blocks IL-2-induced T cell adhesion by interfering with the IL-2 receptor signaling cascade.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PP2A is involved in the IL-2 signaling pathway that leads to β2 integrin activation.
protein phosphatase 1 and protein phosphatase A (PP2A) play an important role in IL- 2 induced homotypically adhesion of human CD4 +T cell lines.
the phosphatase inhibitor okadaic acid (which is a potent inhibitor of protein phosphatase 1 and 1) is a potent inhibitor for IL-2 induced β2-integrin dependent adhesion.
